restaurantName: Zhang Ji Shanghai La Mian Xiao Long Bao
address: Alexandra Village Food Centre, #01-56, Blk 120 Bukit Merah Lane 1, 150120, Singapore
bio: Besides xiao long bao, this busy stall offers an array of Shanghainese food, such as pan fried dumplings, sour and spicy soup. Their pork and chives potstickers are filled to the brim and nicely browned on the bottom....
